admission_rule: A finite source-supported namespace is necessary but not sufficient: its owner repository gitlink must be actually initialized/authenticated, the exact file must occur in the actual candidate install manifest, and any non-Qt/unknown change remains rejected. Conditional-source presence here does not claim upstream build_qt initializes/builds that owner. Literal extra outputs are exactly enumerated and source/installed bytes or generation are checked. Only the seven reviewed common byte-identical raw duplicate headers, and the one ARM-only header when actual architecture cache is arm64, may occur twice; alternate spelling/case and unknown duplicate paths remain forbidden. The finite nine generated SPDX companions require separate install(CODE), log, source/version/root-field and byte proof; they are never ordinary manifest members.

limitations: Literal target definitions and exact generic export rules are authenticated, not a CMake configure trace. Conditional targets may not be installed on Windows.
Aliases represent source-supported private/interface/tool factories; actual install manifest and authenticated owner checks are still required.
Qt modules outside the selected five and conditionally authenticated owner repositories remain disallowed if not actually initialized.
scope: Pinned Qt6.11.1 source namespace ownership proof only; no build, installation or runtime qualification

tool_output_factory.rule: qt_get_tool_target_name adds _native only for QT_WILL_RENAME_TOOL_TARGETS; qt_internal_add_tool sets OUTPUT_NAME to qt_tool_target_to_name at lines178-182

versioned_alias_factory.rule: qt_internal_install_versioned_link delegates to _qt_internal_create_versioned_link_or_copy, generating base_name + PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR + suffix only if QT_WILL_INSTALL and QT_CREATE_VERSIONED_HARD_LINK; COPY_ON_ERROR is enabled
